name: Birren Industrial Colors
description: An unofficial software palette adapted from an Industrial Plants color chart associated with Faber Birren, with seafoam light green as the primary fatigue-reducing field color, white instrument panels for high-contrast work surfaces, and brilliant safety colors reserved for state and hazard signaling.

origin.source: Scanned Industrial Plants color chart associated with Faber Birren
origin.sampling: Original chip hex values are 40×40 pixel averages sampled from the center of each printed color chip in the local JPEG scan. Instrument White is a 40×40 average sampled from the chart paper to represent white instrument panels against the seafoam field.
origin.tuning: A few sampled values are tuned for emissive displays rather than used raw. Holding each color's hue in OKLab, Deep Gray and Medium Gray are darkened to meet WCAG AA body text (4.5:1) and 3:1 component contrast on the seafoam field, Safety Green is shifted darker and slightly cooler to separate it from the routine Medium Green, and two derived neutrals (Muted Text, Mid Neutral) are added to keep low-emphasis text legible and to even the neutral lightness ramp.
origin.note: This is an independent historical adaptation, not an official product from Faber Birren's estate or any rights holder.

light-green.name: Light Green
light-green.intent: The quiet seafoam field color for reducing visual fatigue.
light-green.uiUse: Primary background for editors, reading panes, dashboards, and long-lived work surfaces.

instrument-white.name: Instrument White
instrument-white.intent: A clean panel white that lets the seafoam background read as the room around the instrument.
instrument-white.uiUse: Primary panels, cards, sidebars, forms, modals, and instrument-like UI surfaces placed on the seafoam field.

beige.name: Beige
beige.intent: A low-glare warm neutral, now held back so white panels can contrast clearly against the seafoam field.
beige.uiUse: Warm secondary notes, quiet side material, annotations, and surfaces that should feel archival rather than instrument-like.

light-blue.name: Light Blue
light-blue.intent: A cool daylight counterweight to the green field.
light-blue.uiUse: Selections, linked-data backgrounds, info surfaces, calm hover states, and non-urgent emphasis.

soft-yellow.name: Soft Yellow
soft-yellow.intent: A readable, gentle highlight rather than an alarm color.
soft-yellow.uiUse: Search hits, inline highlights, teaching callouts, and transient attention that should not imply danger.

light-gray.name: Light Gray
light-gray.intent: A cool structural neutral for separating areas without strong contrast.
light-gray.uiUse: Secondary backgrounds, dividers, disabled controls, code block frames, and quiet empty states.

mid-neutral.name: Mid Neutral
mid-neutral.intent: A perceptually mid-light green-gray that fills the gap between the light interiors and the working grays so the neutral ramp steps evenly.
mid-neutral.uiUse: Subtle dividers, disabled fills, secondary separators, and quiet structure that should read above the field but below a border.

medium-gray.name: Medium Gray
medium-gray.intent: The working middle value between the fatigue-reducing field and deep text, tuned to clear a 3:1 component contrast against the seafoam field.
medium-gray.uiUse: Borders, secondary icons, terminal bright black, minimap marks, dividers, and inactive UI chrome.

muted-text.name: Muted Text
muted-text.intent: A dedicated low-emphasis text value, darkened from the old muted gray so comments and secondary copy stay legible against the field instead of fading below readable contrast.
muted-text.uiUse: Comments, captions, line numbers, descriptions, placeholder and secondary text on the field or panels.

deep-gray.name: Deep Gray
deep-gray.intent: A green-charcoal anchor that preserves the industrial character of the chart, tuned to meet AA body-text contrast on the seafoam field.
deep-gray.uiUse: Primary text, title bars, terminal black, high-emphasis outlines, and deep structural accents.

spotlight-buff.name: Spotlight Buff
spotlight-buff.intent: A warm reflected-light color for emphasis without the glare of pure white.
spotlight-buff.uiUse: Warm highlights, headings, terminal normal white, and soft badges.

medium-green.name: Medium Green
medium-green.intent: A stable operational green, more subdued and less alarming than safety green.
medium-green.uiUse: Positive but routine states, strings in code, confirmed status, completed work, and secondary brand accents.

sandalwood.name: Sandalwood
sandalwood.intent: An earthy brown-yellow that bridges neutrals and warnings.
sandalwood.uiUse: Types, tags, metadata, terminal normal yellow, annotations, and low-priority caution on light backgrounds.

medium-blue.name: Medium Blue
medium-blue.intent: A subdued machine-room blue for orientation and controls.
medium-blue.uiUse: Primary controls, functions, navigation accents, selected tabs, and focusable interface chrome.

solar-yellow.name: Solar Yellow
solar-yellow.intent: A brilliant safety yellow for urgent visibility.
solar-yellow.uiUse: Warnings, active search hits, current cursor-line markers, required fields, and focus rings used sparingly.

alert-orange.name: Alert Orange
alert-orange.intent: A high-energy signal between warning and danger.
alert-orange.uiUse: Destructive previews, changed files, performance alerts, numeric emphasis, and escalation states.

fire-red.name: Fire Red
fire-red.intent: The deepest hazard color in the chart: serious, compressed, and unmistakable.
fire-red.uiUse: Errors, failed jobs, delete affordances, diff deletions, security alerts, and badges that require immediate action.

safety-green.name: Safety Green
safety-green.intent: A brilliant go/safe signal distinct from the restful background green.
safety-green.uiUse: Success states, passing tests, additions in diffs, enabled safety indicators, and high-confidence positive feedback.

caution-blue.name: Caution Blue
caution-blue.intent: A saturated instruction blue for labels and command emphasis.
caution-blue.uiUse: Links, command palette accents, important information, terminal bright blue, keywords, and actionable text.
